items.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
items.summary: OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to investigate whether its AI models engage in subversive behavior, but restrictions on access and disclosure raise questions about their independence.

items.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
items.summary: We’re expanding our ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to our frontier models.

items.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
items.summary: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

items.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
items.summary: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, and Transluce, and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards, and monitoring systems.

items.title: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership
items.summary: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch a £1m partnership to help up to 25,000 young people across the UK build practical AI skills for work.

items.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
items.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs....

items.title: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max takes on Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at much lower prices
items.summary: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max, a new flagship model with 2.4 trillion parameters that activates only 71 billion per token. A hybrid architecture sharply cuts costs on long contexts. Qwen4-Max lands just behind Kimi K3.1 Pro on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and Alibaba plans to release smaller Qwen4 models as open source....

items.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
items.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers....

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tackles the Standard Model's toughest math problem on a lattice
items.summary: OpenAI physicist Nathaniel Craig used GPT-6 Astra to tackle a problem that had stumped particle physicists for over 25 years. The AI model took Craig's strategy for defining the full Standard Model on a computational lattice and turned it into a working proof. Craig says a lot of work remains before realistic simulations are possible....

items.title: Airbnb Introduces CASTLE for Training Natural Language Search Models with Synthetic Data
items.summary: Airbnb researchers have introduced CASTLE, a framework designed to address the cold-start problem in natural language search. The approach uses de-identified booking sessions and large language models (LLMs) to jointly generate synthetic search queries and relevance labels, enabling model training before sufficient real search traffic is available. By Robert Krzaczyński

items.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
items.summary: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.

items.title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
items.summary: ChatGPT will ban an account trying to access CSAM content for 24 hours as a warning.
